descriptionHtml:
Case Specifications

  • Model: Aerocool P500C ARGB

  • Case Type: Mid-Tower

  • Color: white

  • Body Material: SPCC

  • Front Panel Material: Mesh for superior airflow

  • Side Panel: Tempered Glass

  • Motherboard Support: ATX, Micro-ATX, Mini-ITX

  • Case Dimensions (Overall): 210 x 465 x 405mm (W x H x D)

Cooling System

  • Pre-installed Fans: 4 x 120mm ARGB fans (3 x Front, 1 x Rear)

  • Front Fan Support: 3 x 120mm or 2 x 140mm

  • Top Fan Support: 2 x 120mm or 2 x 140mm

  • Rear Fan Support: 1 x 120mm

  • Radiator Support:

    • Front: 120/240/280/360mm

    • Top: 120/240mm

    • Rear: 120mm

Drive Bays & Expansion

  • Expansion Slots: 7
